name: rosetta-successive-prime-differences
code:
use default

let limit = 1_000_000
let composite = LIST()

for _ in 0::limit do
    composite.add(false)
od

let factor mut = 2

while factor * factor <= limit do
    if !composite[factor] then
        let multiple mut = factor * factor

        while multiple <= limit do
            composite[multiple] = true
            multiple = multiple + factor
        od
    fi

    factor = factor + 1
od

let primes = (2::limit) |> filter(p => !composite[p]) |> collect_list()

groups(differences: int[]) -> Pipe[LIST[int]] is
    for start in 0..primes.count - differences.count do
        let matched mut = true

        for step in 0..differences.count do
            if primes[start + step + 1] - primes[start + step] !=
               differences[step]
            then
                matched = false
                break
            fi
        od

        if matched then
            yield LIST(primes[start..start + differences.count + 1])
        fi
    od
si

render(group: LIST[int]) -> string =>
    "({group |> map(p => "{p}") |> join(", ")})"

report(differences: int[]) is
    let found = groups(differences) |> collect_list()
    let shown = differences |> map(d => "{d}") |> join(", ")

    write_line("differences of {shown}:")

    if found.count == 0 then
        write_line("  none below {limit}")
    else
        write_line("  {found.count} groups, "
                   "first {render(found[0])}, "
                   "last {render(found[found.count - 1])}")
    fi
si

report([2])
report([1])
report([2, 2])
report([2, 4])
report([4, 2])
report([6, 4, 2])

    od
si
